author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. Contact: DM me or reply.

title: Looking for realistic style character art artists for WIP

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please. Contact: reply to the post with price list and examples.
